records.context: Statistical conventions
records.label: spacr.agreement#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Statistical conventions
records.translation: Tölfræðilegar venjur

records.context: **κ has no value when there is no variance.** κ = (pₒ − pₑ)/(1 − pₑ). If both annotators put every compared row in the same single class, pₑ = 1 and the denominator vanishes: the answer is *undefined*, not 1.0. If just one annotator used a single class, pₑ collapses onto the other's marginal and κ is identically 0 no matter how well they agree. Both cases return ``nan`` with an explanation attached, because on a screen where 98 % of cells are negative they are the *normal* case, and a returned 0.0 or 1.0 there would misstate the agreement.
records.label: spacr.agreement#7
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **κ has no value when there is no variance.** κ = (pₒ − pₑ)/(1 − pₑ). If both annotators put every compared row in the same single class, pₑ = 1 and the denominator vanishes: the answer is *undefined*, not 1.0. If just one annotator used a single class, pₑ collapses onto the other's marginal and κ is identically 0 no matter how well they agree. Both cases return ``nan`` with an explanation attached, because on a screen where 98 % of cells are negative they are the *normal* case, and a returned 0.0 or 1.0 there would misstate the agreement.
records.translation: **κ hefur ekkert gildi þegar engin dreifni er.** κ = (pₒ − pₑ)/(1 − pₑ). Ef báðir skýrendur settu hverja borna saman línu í sama eina flokkinn er pₑ = 1 og nefnarinn hverfur: svarið er *óskilgreint*, ekki 1.0. Ef aðeins annar skýrandinn notaði einn flokk fellur pₑ saman á jaðardreifingu hins og κ er alltaf 0 hversu vel sem þeir eru sammála. Bæði tilvikin skila ``nan`` með skýringu, því í skimun þar sem 98 % frumna eru neikvæðar eru þau *venjulega* tilvikið, og 0.0 eða 1.0 sem skilað væri þar myndi gefa ranga mynd af samræminu.

records.context: **Raw agreement is reported next to κ, always.** 95 % agreement with κ ≈ 0 is the prevalence paradox (Feinstein & Cicchetti, 1990), not a broken annotator: when one class dominates, chance agreement is already almost as high as the observed agreement, so κ has almost no room left.
records.label: spacr.agreement#8
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Raw agreement is reported next to κ, always.** 95 % agreement with κ ≈ 0 is the prevalence paradox (Feinstein & Cicchetti, 1990), not a broken annotator: when one class dominates, chance agreement is already almost as high as the observed agreement, so κ has almost no room left.
records.translation: **Hrátt samræmi er alltaf tilkynnt við hlið κ.** 95 % samræmi með κ ≈ 0 er algengisþversögnin (Feinstein & Cicchetti, 1990), ekki bilaður skýrandi: þegar einn flokkur er ríkjandi er tilviljunarsamræmi þegar nánast jafn hátt og mælda samræmið, svo κ hefur nánast ekkert svigrúm eftir.

records.context: **The interpretation bands are a convention.** Landis & Koch (1977) "slight/fair/moderate/substantial/almost perfect" is a rule of thumb with no distributional basis. It is reported as a label, and labelled as a convention.

records.context: Model-written columns are excluded. A machine-learning classification model writes into this same table — ``pred``/``cv_predictions`` from the CV stage, ``predictions``/``ml_pred`` from the ML one — and its class column is indistinguishable *by shape* from an annotation pass. Offering it made ``agreement_report`` score the machine-learning classification model as a third annotator, which is a different question with the same units: on a real database, four "annotators" gave κ = -0.004 where the two humans agree at 0.471. See :data:`_MODEL_COLUMNS`.

records.source: Model-written columns are excluded. A classifier writes into this same table — ``pred``/``cv_predictions`` from the CV stage, ``predictions``/``ml_pred`` from the ML one — and its class column is indistinguishable *by shape* from an annotation pass. Offering it made ``agreement_report`` score the classifier as a third annotator, which is a different question with the same units: on a real database, four "annotators" gave κ = -0.004 where the two humans agree at 0.471. records.translation: Dálkar sem líkan skrifaði eru útilokaðir. Flokkari skrifar í sömu töflu — ``pred``/``cv_predictions`` frá CV-stiginu, ``predictions``/``ml_pred`` frá ML-stiginu — og flokkadálkur hans er óaðgreinanlegur *að lögun* frá skýringaumferð. Ef hann væri boðinn gaf ``agreement_report`` flokkaranum einkunn sem þriðja skýranda, sem er önnur spurning með sömu einingum: á raunverulegum gagnagrunni gáfu fjórir "annotators" κ = -0.004 þar sem mennirnir tveir eru sammála við 0.471. records.context: Map Barcodes has to be told three things it cannot guess: which mate carries each barcode, whether the reference table is stored in the same orientation as the reads, and where in the read the barcode sits.  Getting any of them wrong produces a processing session that finishes normally and maps nothing, because every stage after the extraction window is working on the wrong bases.  This module reads a bounded sample of the reads, measures each reference table against them in both orientations, and turns the measurements into settings the mapping run can use. It holds no graphical code and opens no dialogs, so the same engine serves the live search in the interface, a notebook, and the tests.

records.source: Map Barcodes has to be told three things it cannot guess: which mate carries each barcode, whether the reference table is stored in the same orientation as the reads, and where in the read the barcode sits.  Getting any of them wrong produces a run that finishes normally and maps nothing, because every stage after the extraction window is working on the wrong bases.  This module reads a bounded sample of the reads, measures each reference table against them in both orientations, and turns the measurements into settings the mapping run can use. It holds no graphical code and opens no dialogs, so the same engine serves the live search in the interface, a notebook, and the tests.
records.translation: Segja þarf Map Barcodes þrennt sem það getur ekki giskað á: hvaða par-lestur ber hvert strikamerki, hvort viðmiðunartaflan er vistuð í sömu stefnu og lestrarnir, og hvar í lestrinum strikamerkið liggur.  Ef eitthvað af þessu er rangt fæst keyrsla sem lýkur eðlilega og varpar engu, því hvert stig á eftir útdráttarglugganum vinnur á röngum bösum.  Þessi eining les takmarkað úrtak lestranna, mælir hverja viðmiðunartöflu gagnvart þeim í báðum stefnum og breytir mælingunum í stillingar sem varpkeyrslan getur notað. Hún inniheldur engan grafískan kóða og opnar enga glugga, svo sama vél þjónar lifandi leitinni í viðmótinu, vinnubók og prófununum.

records.context: Enrichment over chance answers whether the sequences are in the reads.  It does not answer whether they are the laboratory microplate barcodes.  Sequencing adapters are fixed sequences repeated in every read, and a handful of barcodes in any table will resemble part of an adapter closely enough to match it.  That produces a large, perfectly real enrichment driven by two barcodes sitting in the adapter rather than by a laboratory microplate.  The measurement that separates the two is position.  A laboratory microplate barcode occupies one place in the construct and so lands at one offset in almost every read, which is exactly why an extraction window can be proposed for it at all.  A match scattered across the read cannot yield a window and is not treated as a finding, however enriched it is.

records.translation: Auðgun umfram tilviljun svarar því hvort raðirnar séu í lestrunum.  Hún svarar því ekki hvort þær séu strikamerki plötunnar.  Raðgreiningarmillistykki eru fastar raðir sem endurtakast í hverjum lestri, og handfylli strikamerkja í hvaða töflu sem er líkist hluta millistykkis nógu mikið til að passa við það.  Það framleiðir mikla, fullkomlega raunverulega auðgun sem knúin er af tveimur strikamerkjum sem sitja í millistykkinu frekar en af plötu.  Mælingin sem greinir þetta tvennt að er staðsetning.  Strikamerki plötu tekur einn stað í smíðinni og lendir því á einni hliðrun í nánast hverjum lestri, sem er einmitt ástæðan fyrir því að yfirleitt er hægt að leggja til útdráttarglugga fyrir það.  Samsvörun sem dreifist yfir lesturinn getur ekki gefið glugga og er ekki meðhöndluð sem niðurstaða, hversu auðguð sem hún er.

records.context: **A corrected dataset must be distinguishable from a raw one.** A hand-edited mask is otherwise indistinguishable from a segmented one, and it is later impossible to say which microscope fields of view were edited, by whom, or what they looked like before. Every correction here therefore goes through :class:`CurationLog`: an append-only ledger, written beside the artefact it describes, recording what changed, when, and to what. Every correction made through the supported edit methods leaves an entry. The public layer and table objects remain accessible to views and advanced callers; mutating those objects directly bypasses this provenance guarantee.
records.label: spacr.curation#4

Opinberu lags- og töfluhlutirnir eru áfram aðgengilegir sýnum og þróuðum kallendum; bein breyting á þeim hlutum fer framhjá þessari tryggingu um upprunaupplýsingar.

records.context: a single entry out of a ledger's ``edits`` list. Every structured-data name is optional, so an entry written by an older version — or one hand-trimmed in the JSON — loads instead of taking the whole ledger down with it. A missing structured-data name becomes an empty value whatever the field declares: ``""`` for ``kind``, ``when`` and ``who``, ``None`` for ``target``, ``0`` for ``n_changed``, ``{}`` for ``detail``. A missing ``when`` is therefore ``""`` and not the current time, so a reconstructed edit never claims a timestamp it does not have. records.source: a single entry out of a ledger's ``edits`` list. Every key is optional, so an entry written by an older version — or one hand-trimmed in the JSON — loads instead of taking the whole ledger down with it. A missing key becomes an empty value whatever the field declares: ``""`` for ``kind``, ``when`` and ``who``, ``None`` for ``target``, ``0`` for ``n_changed``, ``{}`` for ``detail``. A missing ``when`` is therefore ``""`` and not the current time, so a reconstructed edit never claims a timestamp it does not have. Keys this class does not know are dropped; put anything you want kept under ``detail``.
records.translation: ein færsla úr ``edits``-lista keyrslubókar. Hver lykill er valkvæður, svo færsla sem eldri útgáfa skrifaði — eða sem stytt var handvirkt í JSON — hleðst í stað þess að fella alla keyrslubókina með sér. Lykill sem vantar verður tómt gildi hvað sem sviðið lýsir yfir: ``""`` fyrir ``kind``, ``when`` og ``who``, ``None`` fyrir ``target``, ``0`` fyrir ``n_changed``, ``{}`` fyrir ``detail``. ``when`` sem vantar er því ``""`` en ekki núverandi tími, svo endurgerð breyting gerir aldrei tilkall til tímastimpils sem hún hefur ekki. Lyklum sem þessi flokkur þekkir ekki er sleppt; setjið allt sem á að halda undir ``detail``.

records.source: Every spaCR measurement table has a column called ``rowID`` -- the row of the plate -- and SQLite matches column names case-insensitively, so ``rowid`` in a query means THAT column. It holds 'A'..'P', and ``'A' % 5`` is ``0`` in SQLite, so a sampling clause written the obvious way is true for every row and silently samples nothing. The symptom is a sampling setting that appears to do nothing, which is indistinguishable from the read being slow for another reason.
records.translation: Hver mælingatafla spaCR hefur dálk sem heitir ``rowID`` -- lína plötunnar -- og SQLite ber saman dálkheiti án greinarmunar á há- og lágstöfum, svo ``rowid`` í fyrirspurn merkir THAT dálk. Hann geymir 'A'..'P', og ``'A' % 5`` er ``0`` í SQLite, svo úrtaksskilyrði sem skrifað er á augljósa háttinn er satt fyrir hverja línu og tekur hljóðlega ekkert úrtak. Einkennið er úrtaksstilling sem virðist ekkert gera, sem er óaðgreinanlegt frá því að lesturinn sé hægur af annarri ástæðu.

records.translation: Pörun spáðra hluta við merkta hluti

records.context: Matching is one-to-one and optimal, not greedy. A greedy pass down the IoU matrix is cheaper and gives a different answer when one prediction overlaps two truths: it takes the first pair it sees rather than the assignment that maximises total overlap, so the score depends on label ORDER, which is an implementation detail of whoever wrote the mask. :func:`match_objects` uses ``scipy.optimize.linear_sum_assignment``, so relabelling either mask cannot change the result.
records.label: spacr.scorecard#7
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Matching is one-to-one and optimal, not greedy. A greedy pass down the IoU matrix is cheaper and gives a different answer when one prediction overlaps two truths: it takes the first pair it sees rather than the assignment that maximises total overlap, so the score depends on label ORDER, which is an implementation detail of whoever wrote the mask. :func:`match_objects` uses ``scipy.optimize.linear_sum_assignment``, so relabelling either mask cannot change the result.
records.translation: Pörun er einn-á-móti-einum og besta úthlutun, ekki gráðug. Gráðug umferð niður IoU-fylkið er ódýrari og gefur annað svar þegar ein spá skarast við tvo rétta hluti: hún tekur fyrsta parið sem hún sér frekar en úthlutunina sem hámarkar heildarskörun, svo einkunnin er háð ORDER merkjanna, sem er útfærsluatriði þess sem skrifaði grímuna. :func:`match_objects` notar ``scipy.optimize.linear_sum_assignment``, svo endurmerking hvorrar grímunnar sem er getur ekki breytt niðurstöðunni.
